author: Independent evaluation agent; training fixture and router implementation unread during case construction
fixtureKind: Synthetic paraphrases, independently authored from normative scope boundaries; not production task history
protocol: Verify fixture hash and labels before execution; do not modify labels or router thresholds after viewing outcomes.
Run the model-disabled lexical baseline across every case before fitting or running the learned arm.
Keep top-1 accuracy, top-3 candidate recall, abstention correctness, non-abstained coverage, and selected-context character counts separate.
Train only on the separate reviewed training fixture. Automated leakage checks may compare train/eval IDs and normalized text after this freeze without exposing training text to the evaluator.
Run the optional learned model on the unchanged cases, then compare lexical results to the model-disabled negative control; the learned hint must not silently mutate the baseline or dispatch work.
Report core and neighboring skills separately; abstention is mandatory only for the eight rows marked mustAbstain.
Do not claim real token, provider-cost, task-quality, or latency savings from static character counts or chars/4 proxies.
This fixed synthetic study can expose failures but cannot justify production activation; no minimum passing score is imposed or tuned to results.
Any rerun after repairs retains the original result record and identifies changed implementation hashes; this fixture then becomes regression evidence, not a fresh holdout.
